covers: Circulating temperatures while drilling on bottom: 135 half-hour samples from nine bottom-hole assemblies.
Water-based drilling mud in steel drill pipe.
Bit depths from 1,800 m to 3,339 m measured depth.
Surface return temperature at the same sample depths.
does_not_cover: Run-in, trip, connection or pumps-off temperatures.
Recovery of the wall temperature during trips: the calculation counts accumulated circulating exposure only.
Formation temperatures above the 216-day log's deepest value.
comparisons.measurement: Bit-box temperature from the bottom-hole sensor while drilling on bottom
comparisons.model: BoreTHM v1.5.0 at b9a8a93, nothing fitted to the 16A temperatures
comparisons.modelled_range_note: Each modelled value is the range over four fixed readings: bore and annulus fluid, at the bit and 40 ft above it. The sensor position and medium are unresolved. The range is not a confidence interval.

range_basis.depth_m: bit depth of the 135 compared samples
range_basis.formation_C: 216-day formation log by measured depth at each sample's bit depth, with the log's deepest value held below it, as in the primary case
range_basis.inlet_C: logged inlet range of the compared samples
range_basis.mass_flow_kg_s: not recorded in the 16A comparison tables
range_basis.volume_flow_m3_s: drilling flow range of the nine compared runs

comparisons.title: FORGE 16A: blind circulation comparison

covers: Circulating temperatures: 109 half-hour samples from 13 bottom-hole assemblies.
Recorded drilling mud. Water was run as a sensitivity case on the same samples.
Regular steel drill pipe and, in the four trial assemblies, insulated drill pipe.
Bit depths from 1,265 m to 3,303 m measured depth.
does_not_cover: Run-in, trip, connection or pumps-off temperatures.
An independent test of insulated pipe: its conductivity was fitted on EOW 18, and EOW 17 and 20 supplied the earlier film fit.
A resolved sensor position for EOW 3 and 4.
Recovery of the wall temperature during trips: the primary calculation counts accumulated circulating exposure.
comparisons.measurement: MWD EYE temperature channel while circulating
comparisons.model: BoreTHM v1.5.0 at 85f23db, nothing fitted in this comparison
comparisons.modelled_range_note: Each modelled value is the bore-fluid temperature at the stated sensor position; where the position is unresolved, the range covers every requested position. The range is not a confidence interval.

pooled.group: trial held-out IDP run, fitted conductivity

range_basis.formation_C: not recorded in the S1 comparison tables
range_basis.inlet_C: measured inlet temperature of the 109 samples
range_basis.mass_flow_kg_s: modelled mass rate of the primary mud and water cases

comparisons.revision_note: A later mud-protocol revision (version 2) changed five run means; its biases are shown beside the original version 1 values. RMSE is published for version 1 only.
comparisons.title: FORGE 16B: whole-well circulation comparison
